name: g_hidDisableSelectRemap
comment: Configuration flag in .data controlling SELECT button behavior: when 0 (default), SELECT button inputs (bit 0x04) are automatically mirrored and remapped to START (bit 0x08) via helper 0x0011AAF0; when non-zero, SELECT acts as an independent button without remapping.
evidence: Single byte at 0x007AEA72 in .data (initial value 0x00). Read directly via literal 0x0011276C in Hid_ReadPadState (0x00112640) and via getter function 0x001125AC (literal 0x001125B8) in Input_ReadPadState (0x0010C2D4). When 0, both functions invoke 0x0011AAF0 (via 0x001148E4 and 0x0011AAE0 respectively), which inspects the pad state held, triggered, and released bitmasks and merges/remaps SELECT (bit 0x04) into START (bit 0x08); when non-zero, this remapping is bypassed.

name: g_camSleepCameraState
comment: 8-byte CTR-SDK camera sleep state record in .data: byte +0 holds the combined camera status mask from cam:GetSleepCamera and DriverFinalize, byte +1 is an enable flag checked before querying or updating sleep camera states, and bytes +2..+3 hold initial status flags (0xFFFF). Polled and put to sleep by 0x00114728 before applet suspend/fatal error, and restored by 0x0011A7D0 upon resume.
evidence: 8-byte block at 0x007AF0DC in .data (initial word 0xFFFF0000). Referenced via literal 0x00114790 in 0x00114728 (called by nn::err fatal error applet at 0x0051C2A0 and sleep loop 0x0010D504) and literal 0x0011A808 in 0x0011A7D0. Both functions check enable byte +1, query cam:u service commands 0x003B0000 (DriverFinalize) and 0x003C0000 (GetSleepCamera) via handle 0x007B0054, store the status mask into byte +0, and handle result code 0xC9405001 (Level 25 Status, Module 20 CAM, Description 1) by invoking 0x003D0040 (SetSleepCamera). Previously misattributed to HID/SVC due to code proximity.
